widgets_values: 参考图片1茉莉花胸针这个产品，产品是景泰蓝、掐丝珐琅彩、花丝镶嵌工艺，加金丝银线，螺钿、珍珠和玛瑙及绿松石镶嵌，还配有珠宝装饰，超精致华丽珠宝设计，施华洛世奇调性，展示出产品的高雅及奢华的气质
参考图1产品和图2的产品布局，按以下提示词优化，生产新的产品介绍详情版，图片3是人物模特

### Segment 1 — 茉莉凝香：开场全景

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:00–00:04, 4 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头一" (middle-left). Crop to center the jasmine brooch against the dark background. Preserve the intricate white enamel petals, blue leaves, and gold filigree details.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`A cinematic opening shot of the Jasmine Brooch. The brooch is positioned centrally on a dark, textured surface. Soft, warm light slowly sweeps from left to right, catching the gold filigree edges and the iridescent mother-of-pearl inlay. The white enamel petals have a subtle pearlescent glow. Small Swarovski-style crystals sparkle as the light hits them.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`Start with a medium shot; perform a slow, elegant 4-second dolly-in toward the center of the brooch. The depth of field is shallow, keeping the brooch sharp while the background has a soft bokeh effect.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[高端奢华]"茉莉凝香，传世华章。"`  
`音效：清脆的珠宝碰撞微声，伴随柔和的空气流动声。`  
`背景音乐：优雅大气的交响乐起首，节奏舒缓且富有质感。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Animate from the provided panel as a 4-second premium jewelry commercial opening. The Jasmine Brooch is the hero. Preserve the 24K gold plating, white enamel, and blue leaves. A soft cinematic light sweep moves across the surface, creating glints on the crystals and turquoise. Slow dolly-in camera movement. 旁白：[高端奢华]"茉莉凝香，传世华章。" 音效：珠宝微声。背景音乐：优雅交响乐。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`product deformation, logo distortion, flickering, dull colors, blurred filigree, unnatural light jumps, loss of metallic texture.`

---

### Segment 2 — 非遗匠心：掐丝特写

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:04–00:07, 3 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头二" (middle-left, second panel). Focus on the intricate gold filigree and blue enamel leaves. Preserve the delicate gold wire patterns and the deep blue gradient of the leaves.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`Macro close-up focusing on the traditional filigree (掐丝) craftsmanship. The camera follows the curve of a gold-wired blue leaf. The metallic luster of the 24K gold wire is highly detailed. A subtle shimmer moves along the gold lines, highlighting the "Intangible Cultural Heritage" technique.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`100mm macro lens effect. A slow 45-degree tracking shot moving along the edge of the leaf, emphasizing the texture and height of the filigree work.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[专业沉稳]"非遗掐丝，匠心独运。"`  
`音效：细腻的金属划过空气的微弱嗡鸣声。`  
`背景音乐：音乐节奏稍显紧凑，加入轻微的拨弦乐器声。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`100mm macro animation of the filigree details. Focus on the 24K gold wire and blue enamel leaves. Show the intricate craftsmanship with a slow tracking shot along the metallic edges. Light reflects off the gold wires. 旁白：[专业沉稳]"非遗掐丝，匠心独运。" 音效：金属微鸣。背景音乐：拨弦乐。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`blurred details, messy gold wires, flat lighting, loss of enamel gradient, jittery camera.`

---

### Segment 3 — 珐琅流光：宝石细节

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:07–00:10, 3 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头三" (middle-center). Focus on the central jasmine flower, the pearls, and the turquoise inlay. Preserve the milky white luster of the pearls and the vibrant cyan of the turquoise.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`Extreme close-up of the central jasmine petals and the surrounding gemstones. The white enamel petals exhibit a translucent, jade-like quality. The natural freshwater pearls and turquoise stones show realistic surface reflections. A soft rack focus moves from the turquoise in the foreground to the pearls in the center.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`85mm lens. A slow rack focus combined with a very subtle tilt-up, revealing the depth and layers of the jewelry construction.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[温柔亲切]"珐琅流光，极致奢华。"`  
`音效：宝石流转的清脆叮当声，轻盈灵动。`  
`背景音乐：旋律变得更加柔美，钢琴声切入。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Macro animation focusing on the enamel petals and gemstones. Use a rack focus from the turquoise to the central pearls. Show the translucent quality of the white enamel and the luster of the pearls. 旁白：[温柔亲切]"珐琅流光，极致奢华。" 音效：宝石清脆声。背景音乐：柔美钢琴。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`plastic look, opaque enamel, distorted pearl shape, muddy turquoise color, static lighting.`

---

### Segment 4 — 丝丝入扣：动态光影

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:10–00:13, 3 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头四" (middle-right). Focus on the gold and silver threads and the Swarovski crystals. Preserve the multi-faceted sparkle of the stones.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`A dynamic lighting shot. The brooch remains static while the lighting environment evolves rapidly. Sharp spotlights dance across the Swarovski crystals, creating "starburst" lens flares. The gold and silver threads (金丝银线) shimmer rhythmically, emphasizing the interlocking design.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`50mm lens. Static camera with dynamic internal motion (lighting). Subtle vibration-free zoom-in.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[神秘探索]"金丝银线，丝丝入扣。"`  
`音效：快速闪烁的电子音效，配合光影跳动。`  
`背景音乐：节奏感增强，加入轻微的合成器音色。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Dynamic lighting animation. Focus on the gold/silver threads and Swarovski crystals. Create starburst lens flares as light hits the gems. The metallic threads should shimmer intensely. 旁白：[神秘探索]"金丝银线，丝丝入扣。" 音效：光影闪烁声。背景音乐：节奏合成器。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`blown out highlights, flickering artifacts, dull crystals, loss of thread detail.`

---

### Segment 5 — 优雅搭配：场景演绎

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:13–00:18, 5 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头五" (middle-right, lifestyle). Show the brooch pinned onto a high-end black velvet evening dress. Preserve the contrast between the colorful brooch and the deep black fabric.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`A lifestyle shot of a woman (partially visible, elegant posture) wearing the brooch on a black velvet dress. The brooch sits perfectly on the lapel/shoulder area. As the woman moves slightly, the brooch catches the ambient gala lighting. The scene exudes high-end social status and elegance.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`35mm medium shot. A slow, smooth arc shot (orbit) around the shoulder of the model, showing how the brooch sits against the body and fabric.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[优雅从容]"珠宝交辉，点睛之笔。"`  
`音效：晚宴背景的轻微人声和杯盏碰撞声（极低音量）。`  
`背景音乐：音乐进入高潮前奏，华丽而优雅。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Lifestyle animation. The Jasmine Brooch is pinned on a black velvet dress worn by an elegant woman. Slow orbit camera movement around the brooch. The brooch sparkles under ambient gala lighting. 旁白：[优雅从容]"珠宝交辉，点睛之笔。" 音效：环境背景音。背景音乐：华丽交响。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`unnatural fabric movement, brooch sliding on dress, distorted human anatomy, blurry jewelry, inconsistent lighting.`

---

### Segment 6 — 匠心艺术：俯视特写

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:18–00:21, 3 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头六" (middle-right, macro). Top-down view of the entire brooch. Preserve the symmetrical beauty and the color palette of white, blue, and gold.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`A perfect top-down macro shot. The brooch is laid flat. The camera captures the full layout of petals, leaves, and gems. A "breathing" light effect makes the colors saturate and desaturate slightly, highlighting the artistic composition.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`100mm macro. Slow vertical crane-up (pulling away) from the brooch, maintaining a perfect 90-degree top-down angle.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[赞叹]"细节之处，皆是艺术。"`  
`音效：轻柔的呼吸感音效。`  
`背景音乐：音乐变得空灵，强调艺术感。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Top-down macro animation. Slow pull-back camera movement. Show the entire brooch composition. The lighting should "breathe" to highlight the colors of the enamel and gems. 旁白：[赞叹]"细节之处，皆是艺术。" 音效：空灵音效。背景音乐：艺术感旋律。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`tilted angle, distorted symmetry, lens distortion, flat colors.`

---

### Segment 7 — 东方美学：现代演绎

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:21–00:25, 4 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头七" (bottom-right, second to last). Brooch on a red velvet background with cinematic lighting. Preserve the warm, rich tones of the red velvet and the gold highlights.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`The brooch is placed on a luxurious red velvet cushion. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic (Chiaroscuro style), with deep shadows and bright highlights. This shot emphasizes the "Oriental Aesthetic" and the fusion of tradition and modernity.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`50mm lens. A slow pan from right to left, with a slight tilt, creating a sense of discovery and reverence.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[深情]"东方美学，现代演绎。"`  
`音效：厚重的丝绒摩擦声（极细微），庄重感。`  
`背景音乐：加入中国传统乐器（如古筝或琵琶）的现代变奏。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Cinematic animation. Brooch on red velvet. High contrast lighting. Slow pan camera movement. Fusion of oriental style and modern jewelry design. 旁白：[深情]"东方美学，现代演绎。" 音效：庄重丝绒声。背景音乐：新中式乐曲。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`overexposed highlights, messy velvet texture, washed out colors, shaky camera.`

---

### Segment 8 — 永恒珍藏：品牌终章

**Time Code / Duration:**  
`00:25–00:30, 5 seconds`

**Image Reference Instruction:**  
`Use storyboard panel "镜头八" (bottom-right corner). Final hero shot. Preserve the full brooch on the red velvet, centered and majestic.`

**Visual Prompt:**  
`The final brand moment. The brooch is shown in its full glory. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the brooch perfectly centered. The lighting settles into a perfect, balanced commercial setup. The screen fades to a soft white or remains on the red velvet as the tagline appears.`

**Camera Movement:**  
`35mm lens. Steady, slow dolly-out. The movement is smooth and regal, ending in a perfectly balanced composition.`

**Audio / Voiceover:**  
`旁白：[自信坚定]"奢华之选，永恒珍藏。"`  
`音效：最终的清脆叮当声，余音缭绕。`  
`背景音乐：音乐达到辉煌的终点，收尾有力。`

**Jimeng 2.0 Prompt:**  
`Final hero animation. Full view of the Jasmine Brooch on red velvet. Slow dolly-out camera movement. Perfect commercial lighting. The image is stable and majestic. 旁白：[自信坚定]"奢华之选，永恒珍藏。" 音效：清脆收尾音。背景音乐：辉煌终曲。`

**Negative Prompt:**  
`unstable framing, product fading out too early, logo distortion, low resolution look.`
